name: Ford - Chicago Stamping Plant, Chicago Heights IL

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (41.506099,-87.673466) was ~6 km off, landing on a retail strip on W Lincoln Hwy in Chicago Heights. Correct site is 1000 E Lincoln Hwy at the Chicago Heights/Ford Heights line, ~41.50315,-87.60230, confirmed via web research and satellite (a ~2M sq ft stamping plant, opened 1956, 136-acre Ford parcel).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled entrance off the south side of Lincoln Hwy at a signalized 4-way intersection (~41.5060,-87.6014). Chain-link gate across the driveway with access-control signage ('STOP / NO TRUCK ... ENTRY ... ACCESS ... ONLY'). A former second truck entrance ~250 m west (~41.5061,-87.6045) is barricaded with concrete jersey barriers and out of service.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small structure with a 1-vehicle footprint sits beside the gate driveway just inside the property (visible at z21 satellite and in Street View). Consistent with a guard booth; medium confidence as resolution does not let me confirm multi-side windows.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Gate sits close to the public highway; the approach offers room for only 1-2 trucks before reaching the office parking area.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate is at a busy signalized intersection on a 5-lane arterial (Lincoln Hwy / US-30 corridor); a truck queue at the gate would quickly spill toward the intersection.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock banks are on the building's south and east faces (trailers seen backed in). Estimated 45 total doors across faces; rooftop imagery obscures full counts - low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large trailer drop yards: one on the south/SW side (trailers in rows amid laydown storage) and one on the SE side (~40+ trailers in tidy rows). Combined well over 50 trailer stalls.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple parallel rail tracks and a rail spur run along the entire south boundary with railcars present - heavy inbound steel-coil rail service typical of a stamping plant.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity is split between the south face and the SE face, indicating physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: false - one large connected stamping building; a small detached structure (guard/ancillary) does not count as a separate facility cluster.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main stamping building plus the gate/guard structure = 2.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard areas inside the gate before the dock faces provide ample internal truck holding space.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site sits within the dense south-suburban Chicago industrial fabric (Chicago Heights / Ford Heights), bordered by other plants, a salvage yard and residential blocks - Urban.
fieldNotes.multiStep: No clearly visible second checkpoint after the gate; left false.
